rejected_experiments.result: Best tested batch still increased total and fallback time

rejected_experiments.hypothesis: Smaller score workspaces could improve cache behavior
rejected_experiments.result: Ranks changed across machine states and gains did not clear the acceptance rule
rejected_experiments.reason: Smaller candidates were within about 1-2% under sustained load, changed rank across trials, and did not consistently beat 64 enough to clear the stated acceptance rule.

rejected_experiments.hypothesis: Partial distances can cheaply reject most rows
rejected_experiments.reason: The best exact raw-feature lower-bound candidate was about 1.70x slower than paired V5.1, far below the required stable 10% speedup.

rejected_experiments.hypothesis: Block bounds can avoid exact row evaluation
rejected_experiments.reason: The best exact block candidate achieved only a 0.6809x median paired V5.1/V7 timing ratio and was about 1.47x slower than V5.1; it did not meet the required stable 10% speedup.

rejected_experiments.hypothesis: Contiguous partial partition may beat bounded heaps
rejected_experiments.reason: The bounded heap avoids materializing and partitioning the full distance matrix.
